text:
andre: Quick ping — we're planning a defaults sweep for a handful of runtime flags that currently default to strict enforcement. Goal: switch to safe fail-open defaults and surface the change in the console before flipping enforcement. Want to coordinate telemetry sampling, OPA checks, and an audit trail.
rachel: +1. Which flags are in scope? need to confirm customer-impact matrix and auditability.
andre: initial list: quota-auto-throttle, route-strict-match, kv-eviction-policy, config-propagation-lock. I can paste the stubbed plan later. Low-risk first, high-risk on hold.
sam: we should run an OPA policy dry-run across canary fleet first — policy decisions can hide behaviors. also: console needs a preview banner and a way to opt-in to new defaults per-team.
tess: for telemetry: we can create a dedicated dashboard and flagged events. propose 1% full-fidelity sampling + 5% aggregated counters for the first 48h. alerts on error-rate + latency spikes.
andre: agree. sampler plan: 1% traces, 5% counters. also need to write audit entries for each evaluation: who changed default, previous value, rollout id.
rachel: audit ledger should include config diff + commit-id + rollout-id. can we re-use the existing config-ledger API?
sam: yes, ledger v2 supports diffs but not rollout-id. small API bump needed (add rollout_id string). ops-bot: checklist created: [dry-run job, ledger patch, dashboard, console preview flag, canary OPA run].
ops-bot: to-do: create GH PR for ledger API (label: config-sweep), create dashboard (team: telemetry), add console preview toggle (team: console).
andre: quick example of the dry-run payload we want to ship (for the runtime service):
```
{
  "flag_name": "quota-auto-throttle",
  "action": "set_default",
  "new_default": "fail-open",
  "mode": "dry-run",
  "rollout_id": "sweep-2026-03-21",
  "sampling": {"trace_pct": 1, "counter_pct": 5}
}
```
rachel: nice. For the console: add an "Inspect Effects" button that shows sampled requests impacted in the last hour. show user and route buckets. keep the opt-out per-team in the UI.
tess: +1. Also propose a canary window: 10% traffic for 6 hours, then 30% for 12 hours, then 100% after signoff. telemetry gating must block progression on >0.5% error delta or >15% p95 latency delta.
sam: OPA dry-run results should be ingested into a new dashboard panel: policy-violations-by-route. if violations spike, auto-pause rollout (manual resume only).
andre: sounds good. owners: ledger PR -> sam, dashboard -> tess, console preview -> rachel, rollout orchestration -> me. I'll open the umbrella ticket and link PRs.
ops-bot: created umbrella ticket: https://go/repo/issues/1234 (label: config-sweep). assigned owners.
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime/dry-run-job v1.2.3 -> canary cluster (job id: dr-5567). :rocket:
rachel: I'll prototype the "Inspect Effects" modal tomorrow AM. can someone pair for UX copy?
andre: happy to pair for 1 hour after stand. also: let's record a runbook snippet for rollback: set per-route override back to previous default + trigger immediate ledger entry and notify #incidents.
sam: note: add a preflight that compares computed route-match sets to avoid surprise fanout (we saw this before). small script: `./tools/route-set-diff --from=prod --to=dryrun` .
tess: putting alert thresholds in pager policy TBD — propose pager for SEV2 if errors spike beyond threshold during canary.
andre: ok, next steps: I will create umbrella, schedule the OPA dry-run for 10:30PT, and post links. everyone add checklist items as subtasks. thanks! :thumbsup:
